UX surfaceVite machinery every module build consumes — never shipped to a browser.

Members

i18nFallbackPlugin

Build-time snapshot of the English UI copy (APP + components + not-found) from database.json: the single source of truth for every fallback string in the bundle. CMS edits flow through Firebase at runtime; this snapshot only guarantees the UI never renders an empty label.

  • @param {object} opts Options.
  • @param {string} opts.root Repo root containing database.json.
  • @returns {import('vite').Plugin} The plugin instance.

i18nBootPlugin

Per-locale snapshots of database.json emitted as lazy chunks: virtual:i18n-boot//core → APP, components, pages virtual:i18n-boot//projects → projects The site renders from these immediately (static-first) and revalidates against Firebase in the background (see core/utils/data/db.ts). On the legacy IIFE tier the loader index is stubbed to {} — dynamic import() chunks can't exist in a classic script, so the data layer resolves via REST + localStorage instead (core/utils/data/db.ts).

  • @param {object} opts Options.
  • @param {string} opts.root Repo root containing database.json.
  • @param {boolean} [opts.isLegacy] Legacy IIFE tier — stub the index to {}.
  • @returns {import('vite').Plugin} The plugin instance.
